title: The 88KB Table That Tamed 500 Rows | vitalii.no
description:
How a single React component with virtual scrolling turned a five-minute filtering slog into a two-second search across 500+ job listings.

After just a week of running, JobBot's database held 200-plus job postings and kept growing. Finding something as specific as "IT jobs in Gjøvik with a score above 70 from the last week, excluding recruiter companies" took ten-plus filter clicks and five frustrating minutes of scrolling through an unoptimized table.

I engineered JobTable.tsx, an 88KB React component that became JobBot's central UI. It layers in dynamic column filters, persistent company exclusion, a date-range picker, multi-column sorting, and bulk actions like approve-selected and send-to-email. Virtual scrolling renders only the rows on screen, so the table stays smooth no matter how many postings pile up.

Finding "IT jobs in Gjøvik with score above 70" now takes 3 clicks and 2 seconds, down from 10 clicks and 5 minutes. Excluding every recruiter is a single click, and batch-approving 5 jobs takes just two.
